basics.name: appSize
basics.label: Application size
basics.toolTip: Standard suits most schools. Choose Large for heavy PDF/export usage or many concurrent users. EdSpace scales vertically; contact support before expecting horizontal scale.

options.text: A PostgreSQL 16 Flexible Server is provisioned inside the managed resource group with daily backups (7-day retention by default; retention and geo-redundancy are template parameters for CLI deployments). The Burstable tier fits most installations.

elements.name: pgSku
elements.label: PostgreSQL compute
elements.toolTip: General Purpose is for large multi-school tenants.

elements.name: pgStorageGB
elements.label: Storage (GiB)
elements.toolTip: Storage auto-grows; this sets the initial allocation.

elements.name: enableAzureAi
elements.label: Language model hosting
elements.defaultValue: Deploy Azure AI in this subscription (recommended)
elements.toolTip: EdSpace needs an OpenAI-compatible model endpoint. The recommended option provisions Azure AI Foundry with the models EdSpace is validated against.

allowedValues.label: Deploy Azure AI in this subscription (recommended)
Use an existing Azure OpenAI endpoint

options.text: EdSpace deploys 8 models so every model your school admins can pick in AI settings works: gpt-5.1, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5-mini, Mistral-Large-3 and text-embedding-3-small. Each draws on YOUR subscription's quota in the selected region, from its own per-model bucket. If deployment fails with a quota error, request quota for the model named in the error, or lower the capacities below.

elements.name: aiLocation
elements.label: AI region
elements.toolTip: Decoupled from the application region for model availability. Sweden Central offers the validated model set in the EU.

elements.name: textModelCapacity
elements.label: Chat model capacity (K TPM)
elements.toolTip: Thousands of tokens-per-minute, applied to each chat model (gpt-5.1, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, Mistral-Large-3). This is also a per-request ceiling: a single chat turn larger than this many thousand tokens — a long conversation plus a large attached document, for example — cannot be served at all, and will appear to hang. The default of 800 is sized so even the largest chat EdSpace can build is served. Lower it only if your subscription lacks the quota.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number between 1 and 9999.

elements.name: smallModelCapacity
elements.label: Small model capacity (K TPM)
elements.toolTip: Thousands of tokens-per-minute, applied to each background model used for titles, classification and reranking (gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5-mini).

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number between 1 and 9999.

elements.name: embeddingModelCapacity
elements.label: Embedding model capacity (K TPM)
elements.toolTip: Thousands of tokens-per-minute for text-embedding-3-small.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number between 1 and 9999.

elements.name: enableSpeech
elements.label: Enable speech features (speech-to-text / text-to-speech)
elements.toolTip: Served from the same Azure AI account.

elements.name: byoLlmBaseUrl
elements.label: Azure OpenAI endpoint URL
elements.toolTip: The https:// endpoint of your Azure OpenAI (or compatible) resource.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the https:// endpoint of your Azure OpenAI resource.

elements.name: byoLlmApiKey
elements.toolTip: API key of your Azure OpenAI resource (Keys and Endpoint blade).

elements.name: byoLlmTextDeployment
elements.label: Text model deployment name
elements.toolTip: Deployment on your endpoint that serves chat/text requests.

constraints.validationMessage: Deployment names use letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores (max 64).

elements.name: byoLlmSmallDeployment
elements.label: Small model deployment name
elements.toolTip: Deployment used for background work: titles, classification, reranking.

constraints.validationMessage: Deployment names use letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores (max 64).

elements.name: byoLlmEmbeddingDeployment
elements.label: Embedding model deployment name (1536 dimensions)
elements.toolTip: Deployment serving the embedding model. Must produce 1536-dimensional vectors to match EdSpace's schema.

constraints.validationMessage: Deployment names use letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores (max 64).

elements.name: byoLlmApiVersion
elements.label: API version (optional)
elements.toolTip: Azure OpenAI api-version query value. Leave empty for the provider default.

constraints.validationMessage: Use the YYYY-MM-DD form, e.g. 2024-10-21, optionally with -preview.

elements.name: customDomain
elements.label: Custom domain (optional)
elements.toolTip: Leave empty to use the generated *.azurecontainerapps.io address. Custom domains are activated after installation by EdSpace support — until DNS is configured and the domain is bound, the app will NOT be reachable at the generated address (it only accepts its configured hostname). See the installation guide.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid DNS hostname, or leave empty.

elements.name: mailerAdapter
elements.label: Transactional email
elements.toolTip: EdSpace only emails about getting into an account: magic-link sign-in, password reset and invitations. Choose 'No email' if your users all sign in through SSO — the app then offers a password form, and invitation links are shown to the inviting admin to pass on.

elements.name: mailFromEmail
elements.label: Email from address
elements.toolTip: Sender address for transactional email. It must be verified with your provider, or messages are rejected.

elements.name: mailFromName
elements.label: Email from name
elements.toolTip: Display name shown as the sender of EdSpace's emails.

constraints.validationMessage: Up to 64 characters, without angle brackets or double quotes.

elements.name: mailpaceApiKey
elements.toolTip: EdSpace sends transactional email through MailPace (mailpace.com).

elements.name: mailSmtpRelay
elements.label: SMTP relay host
elements.toolTip: Hostname of the relay. EdSpace always encrypts the session and verifies the relay's certificate.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid hostname, e.g. smtp.myschool.example.

elements.name: mailSmtpSecurity
elements.label: SMTP security
elements.toolTip: This only picks how encryption starts — the session is encrypted and the certificate verified either way. Use 587 unless your relay offers only implicit TLS.

elements.name: mailSmtpUsername
elements.label: SMTP username (optional)
elements.toolTip: Leave empty for a relay that accepts mail without authentication. Setting it makes authentication mandatory.

elements.name: mailSmtpPassword
elements.toolTip: Password for the SMTP username above. Leave empty only if the relay takes no credentials.

elements.name: enableMicrosoftSso
elements.label: Microsoft Entra ID sign-in
elements.toolTip: Adds a 'Sign in with Microsoft' button. Users are matched to EdSpace accounts by email (or by Entra object id when provisioned over SCIM). Can also be enabled later with 'az containerapp update'.

options.text: [concat('In Entra admin center create an App registration (Web platform) and a client secret. Register the redirect URI ', if(empty(steps('application').customDomain), 'https://<generated host>/auth/microsoft/callback — the generated host is shown as the microsoftRedirectUri deployment output once this deployment finishes; add it to the app registration then', concat('https://', steps('application').customDomain, '/auth/microsoft/callback')), '. Under Token configuration add the optional "email" claim and grant the openid, profile and email permissions.')]

elements.name: microsoftTenantId
elements.label: Directory (tenant) ID
elements.toolTip: Your Entra tenant's Directory (tenant) ID, from the app registration's Overview page — only accounts in this tenant can sign in. Enter 'organizations' to accept any work or school account (multi-tenant registration required).

elements.name: microsoftClientId
elements.label: Application (client) ID
elements.toolTip: The Application (client) ID from the app registration's Overview page.

elements.name: microsoftClientSecret
elements.toolTip: The secret's Value (not its Secret ID) from Certificates & secrets. It is stored in the instance Key Vault. Note the expiry you chose — rotate it before then with 'az containerapp secret set'.

options.text: Enter the registry credentials from your EdSpace welcome email. They authorize this installation to pull EdSpace software updates.

elements.name: registryUsername
elements.label: Registry username
elements.toolTip: Username from your EdSpace welcome email.

constraints.validationMessage: Use the username exactly as provided in your welcome email.

elements.name: registryPassword
elements.toolTip: Registry token from your EdSpace welcome email.
